description: Activate Stripe Tax on the merchant's OWN connected account by setting their head-office address (required — it flips tax from pending to active). gocushy merchants have Express accounts with no Stripe tax dashboard, so this is how tax gets switched on for them. Digital sellers keep the default tax code. After activating, add at least one registration with add_tax_registration before any tax is charged.

country.description: ISO country of the head office, e.g. NZ

tax_code.description: Stripe product tax code; defaults to general electronically-supplied services for digital sellers

name: activate_tax
title: Activate Stripe Tax
